fields.inlineHelpText: COLLECTED = ACCEPTED, plus ACH TRANSMITTED (the bank already credited the money; it counts until it turns REJECTED). REJECTED = declined card or ACH return; an ACH return can still be recovered by the bank (Check Collection Status PENDING, then COLLECTED). Each retry creates a new payment, so REJECTED counts attempts, not debts. ACH PENDING = not sent yet. REFUNDED, ACH PENDING REFUND and TRANSMITTED REFUND subtract. More: Knowledge article 'Monee: facturación y cobros (Chargebee y ACH)'.

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c, "REFUNDED"), 
    DATETIMEVALUE(SM_Payment_Date__c),
    IF(SM_Is_Migrated__c,
        IF(CASE(Payment_Status__c, "ACCEPTED", 1, "REJECTED", 1, 0) = 1,
            IF(NOT(ISBLANK(SM_Payment_Due_Date__c)),
                DATETIMEVALUE(SM_Payment_Due_Date__c),
                IF(NOT(ISBLANK(SM_Payment_Date__c)),
                    DATETIMEVALUE(SM_Payment_Date__c),
                    NULL
                )
            ),
            NULL
        ),
        CASE(RecordType.Name,
            "Credit Card",
            IF(CASE(Payment_Status__c, "ACCEPTED", 1, "REJECTED", 1, 0) = 1, CreatedDate, NULL),            
            "Cash",
            IF(CASE(Payment_Status__c, "ACCEPTED", 1, "REJECTED", 1, 0) = 1, CreatedDate, NULL),            
            "ACH",
            IF(CASE(Payment_Status__c, "ACCEPTED", 1, "REJECTED", 1, "ACH TRANSMITTED", 1, 0) = 1,
                IF(NOT(ISBLANK(SM_Transmission_Date_ACH_File__c)),
                    DATETIMEVALUE(SM_Transmission_Date_ACH_File__c),
                    SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c
                ),
                NULL
            ),
            NULL
        )
    )
)

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(
AND(
 RecordType.Name = "ACH",
 SM_ACH_Order__r.SM_Bank__c = "BANCO POPULAR",
 TEXT(Payment_Status__c ) <> "ACCEPTED", 
 TEXT(Payment_Status__c ) <> "CANCELLED", 
 NOT(ISNULL(  SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c ))
),
38 - CEILING((TODAY() - DATEVALUE(SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c  ))),
IF(
AND(
 SM_ACH_Order__r.SM_Bank__c <> "BANCO POPULAR",
 RecordType.Name = "ACH",
 TEXT(Payment_Status__c ) <> "ACCEPTED", 
 TEXT(Payment_Status__c ) <> "CANCELLED", 
 NOT(ISNULL(  SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c ))
),
10 - CEILING((TODAY() - DATEVALUE(SM_Date_ACH_Transmitted__c ))),
null
)
)

fields.inlineHelpText: Result of the bank collection of an ACH payment (BPPR). ACCEPTED = confirmed. NOT_COLLECTED or RETURN = definitely rejected: a new payment is created and transmitted again. More: Knowledge article 'Monee: facturación y cobros (Chargebee y ACH)'.

Card: the day of the charge; it matches Payment Date in almost every case. More: Knowledge article 'Monee: facturación y cobros (Chargebee y ACH)'.

fields.calculatedFormula:
CASE(TEXT(Payment_Status__c),
  "ACCEPTED", "Collected",
  "ACH TRANSMITTED", "Collected - Pending Confirmation",
  "REFUNDED", "Refund",
  "TRANSMITTED REFUND", "Refund",
  "ACH TRANSMITTED REFUND", "Refund",
  "ACH PENDING REFUND", "Refund",
  "REJECTED", IF(SM_Check_Collection_Status__c = "PENDING", "In Bank Collection", "Rejected Attempt"),
  "ACH PENDING", "Not Sent",
  "Other")
fields.inlineHelpText: Collection result of this payment, from the official definition. Collected (ACCEPTED), Collected - Pending Confirmation (ACH TRANSMITTED: counts as collected until it turns REJECTED), Refund, In Bank Collection (ACH return being collected again by the bank), Rejected Attempt (a failed attempt, NOT a debt: each retry is a new payment), Not Sent (ACH PENDING) or Other. To sum collections use Collected Amount.
fields.label: Collection Result
fields.name: Collection_Result__c

fields.calculatedFormula:
IF(Not_Actually_Charged__c, 0,
  CASE(Collection_Result__c,
    "Collected", SM_Amount__c,
    "Collected - Pending Confirmation", SM_Amount__c,
    "Refund", -ABS(SM_Amount__c),
    0))
fields.inlineHelpText: COLLECTED MONEY of this payment, without IVU: the amount when it is Collected or Collected - Pending Confirmation, negative for refunds, and 0 for rejected attempts and everything else. Collected in a period = SUM of this field by Payment Calculated Date (ACH: transmission date). Do not sum Net Amount Signed or Amount Signed: they are not zero for rejected payments.
fields.label: Collected Amount
fields.name: Collected_Amount__c

fields.inlineHelpText: Name of the company of the contract of this payment. Use it to report collections by company (for example SUM of Collected Amount by Company Name). More: Knowledge article 'Monee: facturación y cobros (Chargebee y ACH)'.
fields.label: Company Name
